# Glossary 
# <img src="glossary.png" align="right" height="1000" alt="" />
daisugi is designed as an engine curation metarepo. there are a handful of nomenclature below that will be helpful for navigating the package. all machines are fitted with (x, y) interfaces. the machines are dictated with a prefix verb. Those are listed below: 

## Keywords
#### fit machines with: *`grow_*`*
#### infer machines with: *`harvest_*`*

*num_rounds, iterations, etc. are mapped to the `trees` argument for each machine.*

## Machine Information

in addition to the typical reference page, this should be helpful for practitioners who would like to dive a bit deeper into the root repos, whitepapers, or other information. 

```{r}
#| include: false
# list source, alias, haikus ------------------

ebm <- c(
  "https://interpret.ml/docs/ebm.html",
  "explainable",
  "each feature speaks alone <br> the sum is the whole model <br> darkness becomes light"
)

natural <- c(
  "https://github.com/stanfordmlgroup/ngboost",
  "natural",
  "not a point, but cloud <br> the natural curve of space <br> to show all outcomes"
)

perpetual <- c(
  "https://perpetual-ml.github.io/perpetual/",
  "perpetual",
  "one knob, the budget <br> self-generalizing design <br> no search, just descent"
)

snap <- c(
  "https://ibmsoe.github.io/snap-ml-doc/v1.6.0/manual.html#snapboost",
  "snap",
  "depth rolls like dice <br> decision or linear <br> random number tricks"
)

wild <- c(
  "https://github.com/pyensemble/wildwood",
  "wild",
  "every pruning weighed <br> out-of-bag shadows voting <br> wildest of all"
)

yggdrasil <- c(
  "https://github.com/google/yggdrasil-decision-forests",
  "yggdrasil",
  "sacred trunk rises <br> c++ decision trees <br> fast quiet giant"
)

# combine -------------------------------------------

df <- rbind(
  ebm = ebm,
  natural = natural,
  perpetual = perpetual,
  snap = snap,
  wild = wild,
  yggdrasil = yggdrasil
)

colnames(df) <- c("docsource", "alias", "haiku")

df <- as.data.frame(df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

#| echo: false

  escape = FALSE
)
